rows.normativeRequirement: The runtime shell must consume only contract-validated presentation models.
The runtime shell must not own or infer identity.
The runtime shell must orchestrate only supplied semantic presentation states.
The runtime shell must select the privacy-safe projection when privacy conflicts with presentation preference.
The runtime shell must render governance projections as non-authorizing information.
The runtime shell must render intelligence projections as non-authorizing information.
The runtime shell must coordinate captions through the caption projection.
The runtime shell must consume transition orchestration plans deterministically.
The runtime shell must present interruption state without implying execution authority.
The runtime shell must present recovery state without asserting successful recovery.
The runtime shell must select only the supplied device presentation profile.
The runtime shell must apply supplied accessibility profile facts before optional presentation.
The runtime shell must consume the supplied performance degradation decision.
The runtime shell must select an explicit deterministic safe fallback when capability is missing.
The runtime shell fixture harness must remain metadata-only with flags OFF and activation NONE.
The renderer contract must preserve ONYX as a distinct character binding.
The renderer contract must preserve NOVA as a distinct character binding.
The renderer must preserve canonical identity and version across device variants.
The renderer must use the renderer adapter contract without direct provider coupling.
The renderer plan must cover all eight semantic states.
The renderer plan must make idle motion optional and non-semantic.
The renderer plan must use transition intent rather than operational events.
The renderer plan must prioritize APPROVAL_REQUIRED presentation without granting approval.
The renderer plan must prioritize PRIVACY_RESTRICTED presentation over appearance.
The renderer plan must distinguish RECOVERING without claiming recovery completion.
The renderer plan must remove nonessential motion when reduced motion is supplied.
The renderer plan must preserve state distinction under high contrast.
The renderer plan must provide text-only fallback when rendering is unavailable.
The renderer plan must preserve character semantics on desktop and TV variants.
The renderer plan must require no MetaHuman, likeness, or external provider dependency.
IDLE must communicate inactive presentation without inferring availability or authority.
LISTENING must communicate a presentation state without recognition or authentication inference.
UNDERSTANDING must communicate semantic processing presentation without operational truth.
THINKING must communicate pending presentation without asserting a decision.
SPEAKING must communicate presentation speech state without production voice execution.
APPROVAL_REQUIRED must communicate a request without granting authorization or approval.
PRIVACY_RESTRICTED must communicate restriction and suppress less-private presentation.
RECOVERING must communicate recovery presentation without asserting a completed restore.
PRIVATE_ALLOWED may permit the least restrictive supplied presentation projection.
SHARED_ROOM_RESTRICTED must select a shared-room-safe presentation projection.
PRIVACY_UNKNOWN must fail closed to a safe fallback.
PRIVACY_MALFORMED must fail closed to a safe fallback.
PRIVACY_STALE must fail closed to a safe fallback.
PRIVACY_CONFLICTING must fail closed to a safe fallback.
Restricted privacy must redact captions before caption presentation.
Restricted privacy must use a coarse projection on TV.
Restricted privacy must suppress approval detail.
World metadata must remain separate from privacy-sensitive presentation detail.
Animation metadata must not reveal restricted privacy detail.
Privacy projection must not depend on camera or recognition capability.
Reduced motion must remove nonessential animation.
High contrast must preserve semantic state discrimination.
Captions must be coordinated through the caption projection.
Text-only fallback must be available when richer presentation is unavailable.
Keyboard focus metadata must provide a deterministic navigation target.
Remote focus metadata must provide a deterministic navigation target.
Focused state must remain visibly distinguishable.
TV text metadata must support 10-foot readability.
TV presentation metadata must reserve the overscan safe zone.
Accessibility presentation must distinguish all semantic states.
Accessibility presentation must distinguish restricted privacy state.
Accessibility presentation must distinguish approval-required state without approving.
Accessibility presentation must reduce sensory load when requested.
Fallback must preserve accessibility and privacy constraints.
The world registry must enumerate metadata-only world candidates.
The theme intent resolver must select worlds from supplied intent only.
Level 1 worlds must support static theme metadata.
Level 2 worlds must describe native motion as optional metadata.
Level 3 worlds must isolate local WebM behind an adapter boundary.
The Operations Center fixture must be metadata only.
The Future City fixture must be metadata only.
The nature fixture must be metadata only.
The space fixture must be metadata only.
Reduced-motion world projection must suppress optional motion.
Low-power world projection must select static or safe fallback.
World transition sequences must follow supplied orchestration intent.
World promotion must require provenance-controlled evidence.
World presentation must not claim operational truth.
Ambient audio must begin as a non-executing audio intent.
Audio projection must use supplied availability facts only.
Audio intent may describe speech-aware ducking without controlling speech.
Mute intent must suppress ambient audio projection.
Stop intent must suppress ambient audio projection.
Sensory reduction must suppress optional ambient audio.
Unavailable audio must select an explicit silent fallback.
Ambient audio must not require a voice provider or authority coupling.
TV must be modeled as a first-class interface, not casting.
TV must use an explicit 16:9 profile.
TV must use an explicit overscan profile.
TV projections must retain 10-foot readable metadata.
TV projections must support remote focus metadata.
TV projections must distinguish selected state.
TV projections must support large captions.
TV projections must enforce shared-room privacy.
TV projections must support reduced information density.
TV approval-required state must dominate optional presentation without granting approval.
TV privacy restriction must dominate optional presentation.
TV must select low-power fallback from supplied performance facts.
TV must select text fallback when video capability is absent.
TV must preserve canonical avatar variant semantics.
Performance selection must use supplied device facts only.
Performance selection must use supplied capability facts only.
PREMIUM_MOTION must remain an explicit optional degradation class.
STANDARD_MOTION must remain an explicit degradation class.
REDUCED_MOTION must honor accessibility motion reduction.
STATIC_CHARACTER must retain character binding while removing motion.
STATIC_WORLD must retain world intent while removing motion.
TEXT_ONLY_SAFE_FALLBACK must be explicit and deterministic.
Privacy and accessibility constraints must precede performance preference.
Performance degradation must not silently change identity or semantic state.
